items.title: India Makes Historic Moon Landing Near Lunar South Pole
items.snippet_en: India successfully placed a lander in the moon's southern polar region on August 23, 2023, making it the first country to touch down on this uncharted part of the lunar surface.

items.title: India becomes fourth country to land on the moon, first to reach south pole
items.snippet_en: India landed a spacecraft near the moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, becoming the first country to touch down near this little-explored region.

items.title: India becomes first country to land spacecraft on moon’s south pole
items.snippet_en: India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the moon, with the Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft's Vikram lander touching down on August 23, 2023.

items.title: India is the fourth country to land on the Moon, but the first to reach the south pole
items.snippet_en: On August 23, 2023, the Indian Space Research Organization's (ISRO) Chandrayaan-3 mission landed near the Moon's south pole, making India the first country to land in that region.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3
items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3 touched down near the lunar south pole on August 23, 2023, making ISRO the first in human history to achieve a soft landing near the lunar south pole.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3 lander generated ‘ejecta halo’ on lunar surface: ISRO
items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3's lander module, Vikram, made its historic touchdown on the south pole of the moon on August 23, 2023.
